# Build and test

Tests run against a pinned Home Assistant version with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). Python 3.14.2 or newer is required.

**Check the code**

```sh
uv sync --locked                              # create .venv from uv.lock
uv run pytest
uv run ruff check custom_components tests
uv run ruff format --check custom_components tests
uv run mypy
```

`pyproject.toml` holds the dev dependency group: pytest-homeassistant-custom-component 0.13.367, ruff 0.16.9 and mypy 2.3.1. `uv.lock` pins the full tree.

## Layout

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `__init__.py` | Entry setup, unload, entry migration and action registration. |
| `parser.py` | Decodes one advert. No Home Assistant imports. |
| `attribution.py` | Chooses a person by weight. No Home Assistant imports. |
| `body_metrics.py` | Body-composition equations. No Home Assistant imports. |
| `coordinator.py` | One per scale: Bluetooth callback, settling buffer, pending measurements, notifications. |
| `people.py` | The people hub: profiles, weight history and per-person state. |
| `migration.py` | Moves people from scale entries to the People entry. |
| `store.py` | Persists history and pending measurements. |
| `config_flow.py` | Setup, the People menu and the scale's people list. |
| `repairs.py` | The fix flow of the unknown-weight repair. |
| `sensor.py`, `binary_sensor.py`, `button.py`, `select.py` | Platforms. |
| `diagnostics.py` | Diagnostics with redaction. |
| `strings.json`, `translations/en.json` | All user-facing strings. `tests/test_translations.py` checks that the two match. |

## Documentation

The pages are Markdown in `docs-src`. `jupiter-docs` from [belikh/docs](https://github.com/belikh/docs) generates `docs/*.md` and the site from them. Edit `docs-src` only.

**Check and build the pages**

```sh
git clone https://github.com/belikh/docs .jupiter-docs
(cd .jupiter-docs && npm ci && npm run update:design)
export JUPITER_DESIGN_DIR="$PWD/.jupiter-docs/vendor/design"
node .jupiter-docs/packages/docs/bin/jupiter-docs.mjs check
node .jupiter-docs/packages/docs/bin/jupiter-docs.mjs build
```

Commit `docs-src` and the regenerated `docs` together. `.jupiter-docs` and `dist` are in `.gitignore`.

## Workflows

| Workflow | Runs on | Checks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tests.yaml` | push to `main`, pull request | pytest, ruff check, ruff format, mypy. |
| `docs.yaml` | push to `main` and pull request that touch the pages | `jupiter-docs check`, `build --check` and the site build. |
| `hassfest.yaml` | push to `main`, pull request, daily | Home Assistant manifest and translation rules. |
| `hacs.yaml` | push to `main`, pull request, daily | HACS repository rules. |
| `release.yaml` | tag push | Creates the GitHub release. |
